In [[linear algebra]], let {{math|1=''A''&nbsp;=&nbsp;(''a<sub>ij</sub>'')}} be a {{math|''n'' × ''n''}} complex [[Matrix (mathematics)|matrix]]. The '''comparison matrix''' {{math|1=''M''(''A'')&nbsp;=&nbsp;(''α<sub>ij</sub>'')}} of complex matrix ''A'' is defined as 

:<math>\alpha_{ij} = \begin{cases}
-|a_{ij}| &\text{if } i \neq j,   \\
|a_{ij}| &\text{if } i=j.   \end{cases}</math><ref name="Varga">{{cite book |last1=Varga |first1=Richard S. |title=Matrix Iterative Analysis |publisher=[[Springer Science+Business Media]] |year=2006 |isbn=1-4020-3555-1 |edition=2nd |page=92 |chapter=Basic Iterative Methods and Comparison Theorems}}</ref>
